items.title: Waymo opens up robotaxi service in Dallas to everyone
items.summary: Waymo has dropped the waitlist for its robotaxi service in Dallas, the latest step in the company's bid to scale its self-driving technology across the United States, U.K., and Europe.

items.title: Take an extra $100 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass: This week only!
items.summary: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

items.title: TV Time co-founder launches Bingers to revive the beloved TV-tracking app
items.summary: Bingers is a new TV and movie tracker that revives the social features fans loved with TV Time, while adding support for importing their viewing history.

items.title: Hackers steal over $130M by exploiting bug in offline hardware wallets
items.summary: A security vulnerability in the cryptocurrency hardware wallet Coldcard is allowing hackers to drain the crypto from victims’ wallets. The total losses amount to more than $130 million, according to blockchain-monitoring firms.

items.title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
items.summary: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. The paid tool will let fans create AI-generated covers and remixes of participating artists’ music while ensuring artists opt in, receive credit, and are compensated.

items.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
items.summary: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply. But even Texas can be pushed to the brink.

items.title: Walmart completes its acquisition of TV advertising company Vibe.co
items.summary: The acquisition, which was announced in June, brings Vibe.co into Walmart Connect, Walmart's connected TV advertising platform.

items.title: Elon Musk spends half his time talking robots and AI on Tesla earnings calls
items.summary: An analysis of the last seven years of Tesla earnings calls shows just little attention Musk pays to Tesla's car business.

items.title: Host a Side Event during TechCrunch Founder Summit Week in Boston
items.summary: Want to tap into the energy of 1,100+ startup founders, investors, and tech leaders descending on Boston for the Founder Summit 2026 on June 9? Host your own Side Event during “Founder Summit Week,” happening June 4-10!

items.title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
items.summary: Apple says its trade secrets investigation into OpenAI has widened. In a new court filing, Apple claims additional former staff may have retained or accessed confidential information.

items.title: Spotify now has over 300M subscribers
items.summary: Notably, the company saw its subscriber base swell by 9% in the second quarter despite raising prices in several regions this year.

items.title: India moves to give its instant payments network a business model
items.summary: The legislation lays the groundwork for a potential overhaul of India's zero-merchant-discount-rate regime, under which businesses have not paid fees to accept UPI payments since 2020.

items.title: Is the future of data centers portable? Runware builds a pod to find out
items.summary: On Tuesday, AI infrastructure company Runware announced the launch of its own modular data center called Sonic Inference Pod.

items.title: EON wants to move the data superhighway from ocean fiber to space lasers
items.summary: Endeavor Optical Networks is planning to launch the fastest space laser communications system yet built.

items.title: Bending Spoons to buy Airtable for $1.28B
items.summary: At its peak in 2021, Airtable was valued at over $11 billion, but earlier this year, its shares were said to be trading on the secondary markets at a valuation of $4 billion.

items.title: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
items.summary: After a quarter that delivered $1 billion in profit, Palantir CEO Alex Karp on Monday once again warned that AI frontier labs are too untrustworthy for enterprises.

items.title: Snap CEO sidesteps Specs preorder questions on Q2 earnings call
items.summary: When asked about product-market fit, Spiegel said he believes mass-market consumer adoption won't occur until the end of the decade.

items.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
items.summary: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step toward decoupling apps from models.

items.title: Who’s legally to blame for Anthropic and OpenAI’s autonomous AI hacks? It’s complicated
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic admitted that their unreleased AI models escaped their sandboxes and hacked several companies in unprecedented cyberattacks. Who is legally to blame? Should prosecutors charge the two AI frontier labs? Can victims sue them? We spoke to lawyers who specialize in computer hacking laws to find out.

items.title: Design Arena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
items.summary: Design Arena is used by 5.3 million people around the world, providing critical human evaluations to frontier labs.
